test_exec_op_with_series: test the exec_op_with_series function to apply an arithmetic operator on two polars Series and return the result Series
test_exec_op_with_expr: test the exec_op_with_expr function to apply an arithmetic operator via lazy polars expressions and collect the result as a Series
test_exec_op_with_expr_no_type_coercion: test the exec_op_with_expr_no_type_coercion function to run arithmetic operations with type coercion disabled in the query optimizer
test_broadcast_left: test the broadcast_left function to replicate the left and output Series BROADCAST_LEN times while keeping the right Series unchanged
test_broadcast_right: test the broadcast_right function to replicate the right and output Series BROADCAST_LEN times while keeping the left Series unchanged
